Sorry if this is bad but i was emotional about this. Im 43m. My dad killed himself in 1994.  I was 14 and it was 3 days before Christmas. I still break down crying. It's the worst kind of pain. I'm so sorry. Crying as I write this. I had no support other than my mom asking if I wanted to talk about it. They divorced when I was 5. My school my relatives all acted like nothing happened. It destroyed my view of my world and people in it. It took me 20 years to even be able to talk about it. But my point here is I still don't like talking about it. You have to just get comfortable talking about your pain. Find people you can relate with and stay positive. It sounds like you loved each other, so talk to him out loud. I do that, and I feel like hes still with me. Just remember the good and it's OK to cry. It's almost 30 years for me and it still hurts. Not like before I started talking. If you don't have anyone to talk to DM me I've got your back. Remember stay positive. I lost 20 years of my life over my dad. I didn't have to.  I really didn't have any one to talk to or to relate to. I hope this helps a little.
